sentences.en: The dean shook hands with each of the graduating students.
sentences.zh: 院长和每位毕业生都握了手。

sentences.en: Dean really eats quite a lot, don't you think?
sentences.zh: 院长真的吃了很多，不是吗？

sentences.en: He used to be a professor, but now he is the dean.
sentences.zh: 他以前是教授，但现在是院长。

senses.zh: （大学的）学院院长，系主任,教务长,宗主任牧师,（大学，尤指牛津、剑桥大学的）学监
